name_zh: 新加坡·李光耀：从第三世界到第一与法治精英
name_en: Singapore Lee Kuan Yew: From Third World to First & Rule of Law Elite
description_zh: 李光耀 (1923-2015) 新加坡建国总理 (1959-1990)，1965被迫脱离马来西亚独立，零资源零腹地建立法治反腐精英治理模式，组屋双语种族和谐创造亚洲四小虎奇迹。
description_en: Lee Kuan Yew (1923-2015) Singapore founding PM (1959-1990), 1965 forced separation from Malaysia independence, zero resources zero hinterland built rule of law anti-corruption elite governance model, HDB bilingual racial harmony created Asian Four Tigers miracle.
reason_zh: 李光耀代表城市国家如何通过法治精英治理实现资源禀赋逆转，展示了第三世界后发国家如何通过制度创新超越西方发达国家，其务实主义哲学影响全球治理者。
reason_en: Lee Kuan Yew represents how city-state achieves resource endowment reversal through rule of law elite governance, demonstrating how Third World latecomer surpasses Western developed nations through institutional innovation, his pragmatic philosophy influencing global leaders.
steps_zh: 研究李光耀早年剑桥法学与反殖民主义觉醒
分析1965分离马来西亚眼泪独立与生存危机
探讨廉政公署零容忍反腐与公务员高薪养廉
评估组屋80%拥有率种族配额双语教育社会契约
总结从第三世界到第一法治精英对城市国家治理的全球范式
steps_en: Study Lee Kuan Yew early Cambridge law and anti-colonial awakening
Analyze 1965 Malaysia separation tearful independence and survival crisis
Explore CPIB zero tolerance anti-corruption and civil servant high pay clean governance
Evaluate HDB 80% ownership racial quota bilingual education social contract
Summarize From Third World to First Rule of Law Elite global paradigm for city-state governance
expected_zh: 掌握零资源城市国家如何通过法治精英治理实现发达国家超越，理解务实主义如何超越意识形态成为治理核心逻辑，评估李光耀模式对迪拜深圳卢旺达等后发城市的全球示范。
expected_en: Master how zero-resource city-state surpasses developed nations through rule of law elite governance, understand how pragmatism transcends ideology becoming governance core logic, evaluate Lee Kuan Yew model global demonstration for Dubai Shenzhen Rwanda latecomer cities.
case_zh: 1923 出生；1959 总理；1965 分离；1990 卸任；2015 逝世。从第三世界到第一法治精英范式永存。
case_en: 1923 birth; 1959 PM; 1965 separation; 1990 retirement; 2015 death. From Third World to First Rule of Law Elite paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Singaporean Pragmatism / Elite Governance / Rule of Law
cross_cultural_impact: City-state governance; anti-corruption; public housing; bilingual education; water diplomacy
